name: addpipe24_cla_block3_kstree
rationale: Prior CLA+KS-tree hybrid used 4-bit blocks (6 groups), whose intra-block resolve for the last bit requires a 4-term sum-of-products with a 4-input AND term (c3), adding significant depth and yielding WNS 7.389 at area 524.6. Switching to 3-bit blocks (8 groups) keeps the Kogge-Stone tree at the same 3 levels (ceil(log2(8))=3, exact power-of-2 coverage, avoiding boundary padding waste seen with 6 groups) while shrinking the max intra-block resolve term to a 3-input product (c2), and shrinking the block generate/propagate SOP similarly. This should reduce logic depth/fan-in per stage versus the 4-bit-block hybrid while keeping tree depth equal, aiming for better WNS than the block4 hybrid at comparable or lower area, seeking a new non-dominated area/WNS point closer to the tool-inferred baseline.
